templates.source: https://knowledge.akuvox.com/docs/streaming-and-integration-ipc — Akuvox VC50B/VC50T Video Camera Administrator Guide, 'Streaming and Integration': 'Main stream: rtsp://Device's IP/live/ch00_0'
https://knowledge.akuvox.com/docs/streaming-and-integration-ipc — Akuvox VC50B/VC50T Video Camera Administrator Guide, 'Streaming and Integration': 'Sub stream: rtsp://Device's IP/live/ch00_1'

notes: Akuvox's official IP-camera admin guide (VC50B/VC50T) states 'The URL format of Akuvox devices is rtsp://Device's IP/live/ch00_0' (main) and '/live/ch00_1' (sub). No port is given in the URL, so the RTSP default 554 applies. RTSP authorization is configured under Settings > RTSP; ONVIF under Settings > ONVIF.
